label: SIMULATION of the measurement design, not a result

inputs.lift_definition: absolute difference in conversion, percentage points (jobs/measure/run.py)

formula.total_n: N = ((z_{1-a/2}*sqrt(pbar*(1-pbar)*(1/qt+1/qc)) + z_power*sqrt(pt*(1-pt)/qt + pc*(1-pc)/qc)) / delta)^2, rounded up; pt = pc + delta; pbar = qt*pt + qc*pc
formula.min_detectable_lift: smallest delta with Phi((delta - z_{1-a/2}*se0)/se1) = 0.80 at n_t = 355, n_c = 39 (bisection)

tea_organic.base_basis: seeded tenant, organic 7-day rate for SKU-DARJEELING-TEA-100G at DS-04: 2 buyers / 401 customers homed there (harness.prior_update_demo.organic_rate, seed 20260912, window 2026-09-05T03:30Z to 2026-09-12T03:30Z)

chips_organic.base_basis: eval/raw/prior_update_2026-09-28.json rates_used.holdout: 8 buyers / 401 customers at DS-07, SKU-MASALA-CHIPS-200G

caveats: Normal approximation. With a base conversion near 0.5% the held-out arm (39 customers) expects about 0.2 responders, so the approximation is rough and an exact test would be less powerful still.
Assumes independent customers, one decision each, a fixed 90/10 split and a known base rate; the real base rate is unmeasured on real customers.
note: SIMULATION of the measurement design, not a result. The demo holdout (355 / 39 synthetic orders) is under-powered by design. No lift was measured; the committed Tea result is 1 of 355 vs 0 of 39, inconclusive.
